assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create a lightly simplified, colour-matched alternative of the supplied Saltarello manuscript margin ornament.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its whole composition, canvas size, scale, position, rod length and thickness, horizontal branch reach, overall silhouette, principal cream flower, main acanthus curls and small finished finial at the free end. This is only a modest simplification, roughly 20–25% less secondary detail; retain the graceful richly painted manuscript character.
Input image 2 (the medieval-ornaments headpiece) and image 3 (the medieval-ornaments divider centre) are COLOUR AND PAINTING REFERENCES. Match their pigments closely: softer medium lapis/cobalt blue with worn ivory veins, dusty brick/terracotta red, pale warm antique-ochre gold, sage/olive greens, fine dark sepia contours. The blue, red and gold must read as the same set as references 2 and 3. Replace the target's electric royal blue, brilliant scarlet and orange shiny gold with these softer painted pigments. Keep individual colours distinct and lively, not grey. Matte tempera and rubbed gold leaf, fine flecks, no glossy metallic bevels.
Simplification: thin out overlapping secondary green leaves and tiny gold hooks, remove most berry clusters, retain the principal cream rosette and just one small secondary blossom along the horizontal branch. Let transparent space open between the principal leaf curls. Along the vertical rod keep only two modest leafy sprigs and a few fine tendrils. Simplify the fine vein pattern while keeping hand-painted texture. Keep the small existing free-end finial finished and delicate.
Preserve genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the painting, including interior gaps. No paper, background, drop shadow, glow, text, frame or additional ornament. Do not mirror the drawing or join it to another rod. Output one complete independent ornament with no cropped tips.
This is the UPPER ornament: main flowering branch stays at the TOP and grows right. The gold rod descends along the left and ends in the same compact red/gold curl near the bottom. Preserve that little ending, recoloured to the reference palette.
